packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to an immutable SHA (keep the semver comment)

grpcio, grpcio-tools and protobuf are hard-pinned by robotframework-browser (e.g. grpcio==1.81.0, protobuf==6.33.6). Let it drive their versions instead of proposing independent bumps that cannot resolve.
hexpm/elixir has about one million tags on Docker Hub. The registry tag listing times out (HTTP 504) and Renovate aborts the whole run on a registry 5xx. Bump it by hand in base_images.sh.
debian uses <codename>-<YYYYMMDD>-slim tags, which docker versioning cannot parse. Track the date within the same codename.
quay.io/labmonkeys images use <jdk|jre>-X.Y.Z.bNNN or X.Y.Z.bNNN tags, which docker versioning cannot parse.
fd.io publishes vpp packages only for Ubuntu noble and jammy. Keep vpp on noble until upstream supports a newer release.
base_images.sh pins one openjdk image per major on purpose (LANG_JDK_11, LANG_JDK_17). Do not propose cross-major jumps.

customManagers.description: Base image pins declared as shell exports in base_images.sh
Per-project base image pinned as a shell export in <project>/version-lock.sh. ${VAR} references into base_images.sh are skipped.
netbox-opennms-plugin pinned to a PyPI release in netbox/version-lock.sh
